# Salasah Holding | سلاسة القابضة

> مجموعة سعودية رائدة في تأسيس الشركات، التقنية، المقاولات، والمنصات الرقمية. شريك المستثمرين لرؤية 2030.

Salasah Holding (سلاسة القابضة) is a Saudi holding group operating in business setup, technology, contracting, and digital platforms. Headquartered in Riyadh, serving the Kingdom and the wider GCC. We help local and foreign investors enter and scale in the Saudi market under Vision 2030.

Highlights:
- 20+ years of leadership experience
- 20+ delivered projects
- 15+ digital platforms (including 3dl / عدل)
- Services: company formation (incl. MISA license for foreign investors), tax & ZATCA, GOSI, accounting, HR, IT, cybersecurity, contracting
- Contact: info@salasah.sa · +966 55 950 0173 · Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
